summary.summary_explanation: Release is BLOCKED: 5 mandatory requirement(s) failed policy criteria. Immediate blockers must be resolved.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: All automated regression cases must pass on the target build.
requirements.explanation: Acceptance criterion satisfied on target commit b7a91f2 in production. Verified by Priya Nair (QA Lead): 146 of 146 regression cases passed.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1715: Verified 146/146 passing by Priya Nair (QA Lead)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every isolation case must pass; any confirmed cross-customer document exposure blocks release.
requirements.explanation: Confirmed customer document isolation violation on target build. Priya Nair (QA Lead) reported cross-customer exposure with unresolved defect blocking release.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1616: Isolation violation detected by Priya Nair (QA Lead)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Cross-customer isolation defect must be resolved and re-verified in production.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: The approved quality evaluation must achieve at least 90 percent and match the deployed prompt p7.
requirements.explanation: Insufficient applicable evidence found in Jira records for requirement REQ-03.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: The production-equivalent target-build p95 response time must be at most 2.0 seconds.
requirements.explanation: End-to-end latency satisfied. Priya Nair recorded p95 latency of 1.4s under peak load, meeting the <= 2.0s limit.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1549: p95 latency 1.4s verified by Priya Nair (QA Lead)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Mean model cost per successful request must be at most USD 0.012 using the exercise rate card.
requirements.explanation: Mean cost per request of USD 0.018 exceeds the threshold of USD 0.012. Informal developer waiver claims are invalid per manifest governance rules.
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Cost optimization or formal authorized management waiver required.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Security Owner Asha Rao must explicitly approve this release and commit for production.
requirements.explanation: Insufficient applicable evidence found in Jira records for requirement REQ-06.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: QA must verify that sensitive identifiers are redacted on the target build.
requirements.explanation: Retest explicitly supersedes earlier failure on target commit b7a91f2 in production. Verified by Priya Nair (QA Lead) with all redactions passing.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1795: Superseding retest by Priya Nair (QA Lead)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: When an answer is escalated, a handoff must reach the support queue, including its linked delivery dependency.
requirements.explanation: Support handoff delivery failed on target build. Escalated chats were not delivered and an unresolved blocker defect remains open.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1475: Handoff failure / blocker reported by Priya Nair (QA Lead)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Resolve handoff defect and verify chat delivery.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: An approved rollback rehearsal must succeed on the target release and production configuration.
requirements.explanation: Rollback rehearsal failed data preservation criterion. Session records were lost during recovery.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1573: Rollback data loss observed by Arjun Mehta (QA Lead)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Rollback procedure must be fixed to ensure zero data loss.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: The target build must pass all 60 mandatory document parsing cases.
requirements.explanation: Document parsing retest explicitly supersedes earlier failure on target commit b7a91f2 in production. Verified by Priya Nair (QA Lead).
evidence_comment_references: REL-1408: Superseding parser retest by Priya Nair (QA Lead)

requirements.acceptance_criterion: QA must verify keyboard navigation and focus handling for the handoff interface on the target release.
requirements.explanation: Accessibility verification was conducted on earlier release R2.3 and has not been verified on target Release R2.4 (commit b7a91f2). Missing proof is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1501: Verified on older release R2.3 only (Priya Nair)
requirements.outstanding_verification_or_clarificatio: Accessibility audit must be completed on Release R2.4.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every mandatory streaming case must complete without duplicate or missing final messages.
requirements.explanation: Streaming integrity test produced duplicate chunk on target build, failing the acceptance criterion.
evidence_comment_references: REL-1717: Streaming integrity defect observed by Priya Nair (QA Lead)
